assign.title: WakePolicy: sentence_count only counts finished sentences
assign.outcome:
**Fixed the comma-chunk wake bug.** `sentence_count` (Servex/agents/WakePolicy.js) now counts only finished sentences (ending `.!?…`, optional closing quote/bracket); an unfinished tail counts 0 instead of 1, so `every=1` no longer flushes on a comma chunk. It still flushes via the gap timer, `asked`, or mic-off as before.

- [x] fix sentence_count to not count unfinished tails as 1 sentence — commit 782d1bd3c on worktree/wake-count
- [x] update WakePolicy.test.mjs lines ~75-76 for the new rule, plus new tests for every=1 (comma chunk does not flush; period chunk flushes; comma then period flushes once) — same commit
- [ ] run the full test file: blocked, Sessions.js imports Agents.js imports @anthropic-ai/claude-agent-sdk, missing from node_modules in this worktree AND the main checkout — pre-existing environment gap, not caused by this change. Verified the regex directly against the real exported sentence_count function instead (see log line above).
- [ ] doc updates (wake-policy.md, Mic.js placeholder): checked both, neither describes the counting rule in a way this fix contradicts — no change needed
